analysis:
Examined all units. The PR changes are small: (1) docs/developer/test.md head lines 844 and 919 add the FlintPagedOnlyBackendTests and ModelBenchmarkDispatchTests selectors and state that Flint is paged-only, so DARKBLOOM_FLINT_BACKEND may only be unset or 'paged'. (2) provider-swift/Sources/ProviderBenchmark/ModelBenchmarkNativeQwen4.swift (head lines 38-40) adds modelType == "flint" to a predicate that already lists qwen4exp, prism_hadamard_qwen35 and mimo_v2. That keeps the benchmark from running Flint through scalar generate and its non-paged scalar caches. It is benchmark-only code and does not touch the coordinator WebSocket, attestation, key custody, authorization or the SSD prefix cache (T-041). The documentation text is not executable. The newly documented env behavior (paged-only Flint backend) is a restriction, not a loosening. No new data exposure, auth, attestation or billing path was identified.

Residual unverified contracts: the predicate's caller in ModelBenchmarkNativeQwen4.swift is outside the supplied excerpt, so I could not check what the native path does for Flint beyond the diff comment. I also did not see the implementation behind the paged-only claim, i.e. the Flint backend enforcement and the new tests. These look like benchmark and doc behavior with no security impact, but are not confirmed from source.
